{{Quote|How about an eopie? I'm also part owner of Eopies Extraordinaire.|[[Tevar Shan]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
'''Eopies Extraordinaire''' was a [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] farm co-owned by [[Tevar Shan]]. It specialized in the dwarf variety of eopies. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] Shan attempted to sell the farm to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] during the annual [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]], but was politely turned down.
